Product Disclaimer: Product packaging may vary.
The world-famous virtual diva has returned for her second stop on her Secret Lair tour! In this electrifying drop, Hatsune Miku can be seen across six amazing cards that showcase the power of music—especially its power to bring us together. Don’t miss your opportunity to get a front-row seat to see the digital sensation perform at your game table.
Art by Narendra Bintara Adi, Billy Christian, Aya Kato, Kekai Kotaki, PE-nekoR, and Leonardo Santanna.
Contents:
• 1x Rainbow Foil Diabolic Tutor
• 1x Rainbow Foil Chord of Calling
• 1x Rainbow Foil Child of Alara as “Miku, Child of Song”
• 1x Rainbow Foil Song of Creation
• 1x Rainbow Foil Sol Ring
• 1x Rainbow Foil Thespian’s Stage
